summary: VivoPower PLC filed a Form 6-K disclosing two capital-raising transactions: issuance of ~1.2 million Class A ordinary shares to Prince Abdulaziz bin Turki bin Talal Al Saud at $6.05 per share, raising ~$7.3 million, and a separate direct placement of $9 million+ to two UK/EU institutional investors at $4.20 per share under Regulation S. These are routine equity offerings, not a special situation. The registrant acted as the issuer. No deal terms beyond price and gross proceeds were provided. What to watch: potential dilution and use of proceeds.
